operator is at the tail" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Problem

`SessionView` scrolled to the end on every timeline change. While an agent works, events land several times a second, so reading anything

earlier was impossible: the view snapped back on the next event.

## Change

- New `composables/useTailScroll.ts`: "at the tail" is measured from the scroller's `scroll` event (within 32 px of the bottom) and re-measured after
each jump. New content scrolls to the end only while at the tail; otherwise `scrollTop` is left alone and the arrivals are counted.\n- `SessionView`: a `↓ N new` / `↓ New activity`
pill (a real `<button>`) sits at the bottom of the scroller when the operator is scrolled up and something arrived. Tapping it jumps to the end; it clears on

its own when they scroll back to the tail. Sending a message, answering an ask and opening a session always jump. Streaming text counts as activity. `overflow-anchor: auto` on the timeline; the explicit check remains the source of truth.
\n- Test covers: at tail → new event → scrolled to end; scrolled up → new event → position unchanged, pill visible with count; tap pill → end, p

ill gone; scroll back to tail → pill gone; scrolled up → send → end.
- `docs/architecture.md`: one sentence under `SessionView`.

PWA only; no protocol change; no new dependency.
